# Contract: primary-source-research

Third-party skill from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) (MIT, Matt Pocock), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Research notes from primary sources, saved in the repo). The method is upstream. Category: learning. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Investigate a question against primary sources and write one Markdown file in the repo with a citation on every claim.

## Use it for
- "research this against the official docs and save notes"
- "write up what the spec actually says"

## Not for
- a learning plan (learn-a-domain)
- implement a paper (paper-to-runnable)
- a case study of work already done (work-to-explanation)

## Accepted inputs
A question, and permission to read the sources.

## Deliverables
One Markdown file of findings, each claim cited.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- none

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Reads sources the user can open (docs, code, specs). Does not call a paid research API.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.
